accordion: Collapsible sections with single or multiple selection.
alert: Status message with a built-in icon.
area-chart: Filled bands over time, stacked or overlaid.
attachment: File row with upload states, built on Item.
avatar: User image with an initials fallback and an optional badge overlay.
badge: Compact status label, dot, or notification count.
bar-chart: Categories compared by length, grouped or stacked.
bottom-sheet: Draggable sheet anchored to the bottom of the screen.
breadcrumb: The trail of links back up the hierarchy to the current page.
button: Pressable action with variants, sizes, loading state and icon slots.
button-group: Several buttons drawn as one control — a segmented run, a split action, a toolbar.
react native button group segmented control split button
card: Content surface with header, body and footer.
calendar: A month of days, for picking one, several, or a range.
carousel: A run of slides, one at a time, dragged with a finger.
checkbox: Animated checkbox, as a row or a selectable card.
chip: Interactive pill — a filter, a tag, or a removable token.
color-picker: A colour chosen by dragging — a saturation square or a wheel, a hue scale, and opacity.
date-time-picker: A day and a time of day, picked in one panel.
react native date time picker component
dialog: Modal dialog with a backdrop and footer actions.
direction: Reading direction for everything below it.
drawer: A panel that comes in from an edge of the screen and covers the app until dismissed.
empty-state: Placeholder for a list or screen with no content.
fab: The floating action button — one action pinned over the content, with an optional dial of others behind it.
react native floating action button fab speed dial
field: Layout and validation-state kit a form control composes into.
form: Form state — values, validation and submission — with no form library underneath.
flow: Pan-and-zoom canvas of draggable nodes joined by animated edges.
react native node graph flow diagram
frame: Widget shell — a card of rows sitting in a titled tray.
heatmap-chart: Contribution grid with a themed colour ramp and a readout.
input: Text field with label, description and error message.
input-group: Input with leading and trailing decorators.
number-input: Numeric field stepped by buttons or typed by hand.
otp-input: One-time-code field drawn as a row of separate cells.
pagination: Paged navigation over a long result set.
grid-item: Bento tiles, and the grid that places them.
react native bento grid tile component
item: Row of media, text and actions for lists and settings.
label: Label
Form field label with required, invalid and disabled states.
react native form label
line-chart: Animated time series, drawn on the UI thread.
loader: Nine loading animations behind one variant prop.
markdown-editor: A field for writing markdown, with a formatting toolbar and a rendered preview.
react native markdown editor preview toolbar
map: Vector map whose basemap is drawn from your theme tokens.
react native map maplibre markers clusters
menu: The list of things you can do to something.
message: Chat turn with avatar, bubble, header and footer.
message-scroller: Scroll behaviour a chat transcript needs.
popover: Panel anchored to the element that opened it.
questionnaire: One question at a time, with progress, validation and a way back.
rating: A row of stars to read or set a score.
pie-chart: One whole, divided between its parts.
ring-chart: Concentric arcs, each measured against its own target.
react native ring chart radial progress gauge
scatter-chart: Two quantities against each other, to show how they relate.
scroll-canvas: Image frame whose contents move as you scroll.
scroll-fade: Fades the edges of a scroll container.
scroll-text: Text that resolves word by word as you scroll.
text-animation: Five ways a piece of text or a number arrives.
react native typewriter animated counter text animation
section-rail: Floating section navigator for a long screen.
select: Picker shown in a bottom sheet, expanded in place, or floating over the page.
separator: Horizontal or vertical rule between content, optionally labelled.
signature: Sign with a finger, and get the result back out as SVG or PNG.
slider: Pick a value, or a span, by dragging a thumb along a track.
surface: Elevated container with a variant ladder.
swipe: A row that slides aside to reveal the things you can do to it.
react native swipe to delete list row actions
table: Rows and columns that stay lined up, with sortable headers.
tabs: Segmented navigation with an animated indicator.
textarea: Text field that runs to several lines, sized in rows.
time-picker: A time of day, as a wheel, a clock or a swipeable scale.
toast: Transient notification queue with swipe to dismiss.
toggle-button: A button that stays down, on its own or in a group.
tooltip: A small label that names the control under your finger.
thinking-orb: Dotted orb saying which kind of busy an agent is.
soundwave: What a voice looks like while an app listens.
reasoning: The model's working, shown while it happens and folded away after.
sources: Where an answer came from, folded under a count.
task: One step an agent took, and what it did while it was there.

code-block: A fenced snippet, syntax-coloured and scrolled sideways.
react native code block syntax highlighting
combobox: A text field that filters a list of options as you type.
plan: What an agent intends to do, before it does it.
post: A social card — author, body, media and the counts underneath, with the votes animated.
react native social post card component
response: A model's answer, rendered as markdown while it is still arriving.
react native ai streaming markdown renderer
panelside: Navigation panel that moves the app aside instead of covering it.
react native ai app navigation drawer
kpi: One number, what it is doing, and the shape it made getting there.
react native kpi metric stat card
radar-chart: Several measures of one thing, drawn as one shape.
react native radar chart spider web
tree: A hierarchy you can open a level at a time.
react native tree view file explorer hierarchy
sortable: A list whose rows can be dragged into a different order.
